appearance_facts.fact: A single pie chart occupies the central area beneath the title.
A pale yellow wedge labeled 'Nuclear (40%)' spans from the top vertical radius down to the left side; it is the largest angular slice.
An orange wedge labeled 'Fossil Fuels (15%)' spans from the top vertical radius to the right side; it is the smallest angular slice.
A red wedge labeled 'Hydroelectric (25%)' spans the lower-left region.
A reddish-orange wedge labeled 'Renewables (20%)' spans the lower-right region.
Visually, the Nuclear wedge covers the greatest area, followed by Hydroelectric, then Renewables, then Fossil Fuels.
